summary: Backend regression testing for PROSIC (Express+FastAPI proxy). Executed 14 pytest tests covering auth, Google Sheets (unconfigured), rentals public (identity + Stripe placeholder), quotes/postal-zones, and equipment public catalog. All 14 tests passed (100%). Stripe placeholder returns 500 with clear 'Invalid API Key' message (acceptable per request). Sheets endpoints correctly return 400 when GOOGLE_SHEETS_ID/GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY are missing.

minor.issue: Endpoint mentioned in review request does not exist. Actual public catalog route is /api/equipment/catalog (see routes/equipment_public.ts). /api/equipment is protected (401 without token). Only doc mismatch — code behavior is correct.

Returns 500 (not 503) with 'Invalid API Key' because STRIPE_SECRET_KEY='sk_test_emergent' passes the truthy check in getStripe(). Consider validating key format (sk_test_/sk_live_) and short-circuiting to 503 STRIPE_NOT_CONFIGURED for consistency. Acceptable per request but worth hardening.

action_items: OPTIONAL: In rentals_public.ts getStripe(), reject placeholder keys (e.g. reject when key === 'sk_test_emergent' or doesn't match /^sk_(test|live)_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}$/) so unconfigured Stripe returns 503 instead of a downstream 500 from the SDK.
OPTIONAL: Add explicit public route /api/equipment/public (or update docs/tests) so the storefront catalog endpoint is discoverable — current name is /api/equipment/catalog.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py wrapper: node subprocess is spawned in FastAPI lifespan, which fights supervisor semantics. If uvicorn reloads or receives multiple workers, multiple node processes could bind :5000. OK for single-worker preview but flag it.

sheets.ts /sheets/sync export loop swallows individual tab errors but still writes a 'partial' log — good; however when isConfigured() is false and there are no credentials the sync insert of sheetsSyncLogTable happens unconditionally: fine for audit.

rentals_public.ts recomputes totals server-side (good, anti-tamper) but falls back to Number(monto_total) when safeTotal <= 0 — a malicious payload with dias_renta=0/costo_renta=0 could still inject an arbitrary monto_total. Recommend rejecting when safeTotal <= 0.
quotes.ts uses Date.now() for folio: potential collision under high concurrency. Consider adding random suffix or DB-generated sequence.
auth.ts uses in-code createSession/verifyPassword; ensure JWT_SECRET is rotated in prod (currently 'prosic_dev_secret_change_me' in .env).
seed_data_creation: None. Tests create idempotent quote rows (folio COT-<timestamp>) and a sheets_sync_log 'error' row per sync/import failure call. No cleanup performed; considered log-audit rows and are safe to keep.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Base URL: http://127.0.0.1:8001 (FastAPI proxy on :8001 → node Express on :5000). No REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL in frontend/.env — the frontend uses VITE_API_URL=/api. Sheets routes are UNDER auth middleware (requireAuth), so they need Bearer token; the pytest fixture auth_headers handles this. Stripe placeholder key 'sk_test_emergent' triggers a real Stripe SDK call which returns 500 'Invalid API Key' (not 503). Public catalog endpoint is /api/equipment/catalog (NOT /public). All 14 tests in /app/backend/tests/test_prosic_backend.py green.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs blocking flow. Two minor RCA notes: (1) getStripe() in rentals_public.ts only checks `if (!key) return null`, so any non-empty placeholder is treated as configured and the Stripe SDK throws → 500. Mitigation: validate key regex. (2) Review request referenced /api/equipment/public which doesn't exist in code; the actual public route is /api/equipment/catalog.
